summary: Overdue-hiker callout for a hiker whose plan was to summit Ellingwood Point and Blanca Peak by 14:00 and reach the Wetterhorn trailhead (approach unknown: Lake Como or Zapata); missed 21:00 check-in; AVSAR phone ping failed (phone off); deputies checked Zapata Falls and Lake Como Road trailheads with no vehicle found; subject texted his mother that he was okay but had no cell service; stand-down ~01:55 on 8/26
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR + Alamosa County Sheriff's Office
notes: Run 612 Little Bear targeted fill; AVSAR mission page opened by parent this run (AVSAR's own slug typo '2109' for 2019); self-resolved stand-down, subject located alive; fills thin year 2019 for this line
